status: Scoped Go input-buffer alignment. Mixed timing results; no overall performance or whole-package parity claim.
source_authority: pkg/server/internal/util/buffered_read_conn.go: DefaultReaderSize = 16 * 1024; Read delegates to bufio.Reader. pkg/server/internal/packetio.go frames packets above that buffered connection.
change: Use native std::io::BufReader at the authenticated command boundary, below compression and above ClientStream. Preserve raw authentication/TLS upgrade, packet framing, limits, timeouts, output batching and shutdown ownership. Additional input capacity is 16 KiB per authenticated connection.

workloads.correctness: Exact work and zero errors. Fresh Go SQL digest ad1e46405a9ace48963d51a9608eb036609ada257d87fffd4943b3b79a144a4c matches Rust; all eleven live TPC-C consistency conditions pass.

profiles.method: Separate 12000-event serial sysbench runs for before/after/Go; eight-second Rust Time Profiler and Go pprof captures. No builds or profiling overlapped timing.
profiles.call_chain: Rust before: PacketIoReader -> read_header_or_eof -> ClientStream -> rustls complete_io -> recvfrom. After: PacketIoReader -> BufReader -> ClientStream -> rustls complete_io -> recvfrom. Go: clientConn.readPacket -> packetIO.readOnePacket -> BufferedReadConn/bufio -> TLS/net read.
profiles.finding: Both Rust traces show TLS on the actual MySQL receive path. This sysbench driver's --mysql-ssl=off skips SSL configuration instead of explicitly setting SSL_MODE_DISABLED; do not label these runs plaintext. The new buffer does not remove TLS record reads.
profiles.limit: Sampled weights are not syscall counts or directly comparable to Go pprof units. No read-syscall performance win inferred from these profiles.

measurement_limits: Two pairs on a local shared-host fixture. TPC-C Go anchors drift from 6.4105 to 6.9612 seconds. Small differences do not establish a broad improvement. Live Go is TiDB 23bff313186b8ceb61fcbe9faac43ae700e7fb14, not checkout Go master.
